reason: I have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years at zero software cost, and my team's habits are set in stone. Asking us to adopt a new system with a ₹12,990 annual commitment introduces friction we simply do not need when our current setup works fine.
objection: We have run our entire practice on WhatsApp groups and Excel for a decade without paying for software, so retraining my staff and changing our workflow feels unnecessary.
would_change_my_mind: Direct WhatsApp group ingestion that automatically routes documents into Drive folders without requiring my team to learn or maintain a new portal.
